thread:
incident-bot: PAGING oncall - sustained degradation on /v1/chat/stream in ap-southeast-1. Symptoms: incremental request_queue > 1k, request_shed ~35%, 5xx rate 30% for 6m. grafana: https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/1967001234
Ben R: I'm awake. pulling request traces and pool metrics. looks like a small set of long-running streamed chats are occupying slots.
Hannah M: yep, streaming sessions holding KV cache and preventing short requests from executing. affected pool: ap-gpu-1, max_in_flight per-host=150 but many long polls.
Ben R: customers impacted: mostly self-serve + some API sandbox users. Dedicated customers on private plane unaffected. CS - Omar, are any paid customers on hosted in the region impacted?
CS - Omar: 4 paying customers saw elevated errors, pinging them now. will advise short retry/backoff and note we're mitigating.
Hannah M: mitigation options: A) reduce max_in_flight 150->50 B) implement short-circuit for streaming routes for anonymous keys C) enable per-route concurrency limit e.g., route-level max_concurrency=20 for /v1/chat/stream D) globally tighten slot_wait_timeout E) temporarily increase shedding threshold for low-priority tokens to 1 (immediate 429) F) disable tool-calls for unauth tokens.
Ben R: priority: do A + C + B. changing max_in_flight to 50 then apply router-level limiter. rollback path is clear.
Ben R: patching pool config:
```
kubectl patch configmap runtime-pool-ap -n infra --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/pools/ap-gpu-1/max_in_flight","value":50}]'
```
ops-bot: Patch applied to runtime-pool-ap (cfg_sha: e3f1c2). Controller scheduled rolling update.
Hannah M: controller observed drains. inflight per-host dropped from ~140 to ~45 over 70s. queue depth falling. errors down to 15%.
Ben R: adding route-level concurrency guard on router to protect short chat routes:
```
POST /router/limits
{"match":"path:/v1/chat/stream && auth:anonymous","max_concurrency":20,"queue_size":5,"reason":"incident-1967001234"}
```
ops-bot: Router limit created id=rl-430.
Hannah M: also toggled streaming short-circuit for anonymous via flags:
```
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood/api/flag -d '{"flag":"streaming_allow_anonymous","value":false}'
```
ops-bot: Flag streaming_allow_anonymous set=false.
CS - Omar: updated customers and provided workaround: switch to non-streaming endpoint with polling or request smaller chunk sizes. two customers requested 1:1 calls. scheduling.
Ben R: metrics now show p95 down from 5.9s -> 2.2s, p99 down from 12s -> 5.6s. shed rate at 8%. We should still tighten slot wait to avoid head-of-line. proposal: set slot_wait_timeout 25s (was 60s).
Hannah M: applying timeout tweak:
```
./ctl update-runtime --pool ap-gpu-1 --set slot_wait_timeout=25s
```
ops-bot: Runtime timeout updated.
Ben R: also we should add a temporary global per-key RPS rule for trial/unverified keys to 3rps to curb abusive bursts.
Hannah M: adding quota rule:
```
POST /edge/quotas
{"selector":"key_meta:trial,auth:anonymous","limit":3,"burst":10,"duration":900}
```
ops-bot: Quota q-915 created.
Ben R: after all measures, errors ~2.1%, queue depth ~baseline. KV eviction rate normalized.
Hannah M: note: we disabled anonymous streaming and reduced max_in_flight; these will impact latency for some long-run users but improve overall tail. revert plan in 30m if stable.
oncall-next - Mei: handoff in 15m. leaving this for you; will watch the next 45m. current mitigations to record: max_in_flight=50, router-rl-430 active, streaming_allow_anonymous=false, quota q-915, slot_wait_timeout=25s.
CS - Omar: sent targeted messages to 4 paid customers; two accepted help calls. logging customer responses in support ticket 98321.
Ben R: runbook for rollback (short):
- kubectl patch configmap runtime-pool-ap to set /pools/ap-gpu-1/max_in_flight back to 150
- DELETE /router/limits/rl-430
- curl to set streaming_allow_anonymous=true on flags service
- DELETE /edge/quotas/q-915
- ./ctl update-runtime --set slot_wait_timeout=60s
Hannah M: I also noted we should follow up in postmortem on: why streaming sessions monopolized KV caches, whether we need per-connection eviction policy, and whether we should enforce shorter server-side idle timeouts for streams.
incident-bot: Post-incident creation reminder scheduled: create_incident(1967001234) in 1h.
Ben R: thanks team. I'll post a short timeline after rollback.
oncall-next - Mei: thanks, I'll take it from here in 10m.
Hannah M: end.
